messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR that bundles the on-prem installer packaging notes with an air-gapped image/import example and a simple KMS->HSM proxy snippet. Need infra/security eyes.

aj: ack, will take a look. main concerns: TLS to HSM and proxy routing rules.

kevin: For offline package mirrors we should show both yum/dnf and apt examples. Proposal for apt mirror snippet to include in the guide:
```
# on mirror host
reposync -p /var/www/html/repo --repoid=redwood-onprem
createrepo /var/www/html/repo
# serve with nginx or simple file server
```

sam: also add container image import steps for containerd (air-gapped import). Short snippet to copy into the quickstart section:
```
# transfer the saved image tarball to target host, then:
ctr images import redwood-server-1.4.tar
ctr images tag docker.io/redwood/server:1.4 redwood/server:1.4
systemctl restart redwood-server
```

lina: For the KMS proxy, here's a minimal `socat` + systemd unit example we can surface (keeps it simple for ops):
```
[Unit]
Description=KMS proxy tunnel
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/socat TCP-LISTEN:4632,fork TCP:10.0.0.5:4632
Restart=always
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

maria: @lina nice — include a note to run the tunnel on a bastion or a dedicated network hop and call out MTU considerations. Also show an example curl through the proxy for validation:
`curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" http://127.0.0.1:4632/v1/keys`

aj: small nit — keep port 4632 consistent and add firewall/NAT examples. Quick iptables example to drop into the networking appendix:
```
# allow KMS proxy port on host
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 4632 -j ACCEPT
# if using nftables:
nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 4632 accept
```

kevin: Also included: a sample PKCS#11 config line for the HSM section. Example path for SoftHSM or vendor libs: `/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so` and a short hint about `pin`/`slot` usage.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — branch: docs/onprem/packaging-kms-proxy. Requested reviewers: @aj @lina @security-team :sparkles:

sam: I'll run quick copy edits and check headings/anchors. Can someone generate a staging preview for the PR so we can validate code block rendering?

infra-bot: Staging preview created: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr/4321 — includes rendered code blocks and table of contents.

maria: Thanks. If reviewers could comment inline on the \"air-gapped image import\" section before EOD that would be great. I want to merge the initial guide and follow with a troubleshooting PR.

aj: will do; focusing on network/NAT and HSM access parts.

lina: left a comment about adding `User=` to the systemd unit (security best practice) and a short note to rotate the socat process in case of leaks. :thumbsup:

kevin: Fixed the TOC anchor for `#kms-proxy` and updated the relative link in the install checklist. Also added a short sentence about keeping the KMS endpoint private when using a bastion.

maria: great — plan is to merge once all comments are resolved. I'll also file a follow-up PR to add tcpdump/troubleshooting commands if we want packet-level debug examples.

sam: noted, I'll open the follow-up for expanding troubleshooting and sample logs (systemd + containerd).

maria: thanks team :tada:
